2000379.description: In accordance with the terms of our license, we are discontinuing access to S&P and DJ indices with the prefixes SPCFD, DJCFD and CBOE. The symbols are available from the official datafeeds - SP and DJ — it is now necessary to acquire the appropriate real-time data subscription.
2000379.title: S&P and DJ indices official datafeed

2000380.description: CSE Canada real-time data is going to be available only with a paid subscription in accordance with our new license — starting tomorrow. Delayed data will be available for all.
2000380.title: Access to CSE Canada real-time data
